title: Suburban Lawn Landscaping, 1950s B&W Snapshot, US
description: A mid-century post-war suburban scene depicting three people working on the front yard of a freshly built two-story brick colonial home. One man moves dirt with a wheelbarrow while two women work with rakes and shovels on the tilled earth. Other similar tract homes are visible in the background, encapsulating the 1950s American suburban boom.
